# möbius for macOS 0.2.4

- Closing a browser tab no longer sends möbius to the menu bar, as if it had quit.
  The same applies when a page closes itself, such as a sign-in window.
- Your möbius Cloud gateway is named möbius Cloud or möbius Cloud Plus, as on iPhone,
  instead of its long server address. Gateways you renamed keep your name.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Works with the same gateway (0.15.53,
protocol 86) as 0.2.0 through 0.2.3.
